extraction_notes: Forward and reverse curves were digitized from the supplied vector plots without adding interpolated points; the grouped curves explicitly include DSK22.
Fig. 3 DSK22-DSK24 curve is a typical forward curve at Tj=25 degC, pulse width=300 us, and 1% duty cycle; its y-axis is logarithmic and its plotted current is instantaneous forward current.

Fig. 4 DSK22-DSK26 solid curves show instantaneous reverse-current magnitude versus percent of rated peak reverse voltage at Tj=25 degC and Tj=100 degC; plotted reverse-current polarity is represented as positive magnitude.

The electrical-characteristics table gives IR1 maximum 0.2 mA for the DSK22-DSK210 group at VR=VDC and TA=25 degC. The separate IR2 high-temperature maximum is 20 mA for the DSK22-DSK210 group at VR=VDC and TA=100 degC; it is not used as the reverse-current fit target.
Absolute-rating bounds for DSK22 are VRRM=20 V, VRMS=14 V, VDC=20 V, IF(AV)=2.0 A, and IFSM=50 A at TA=25 degC; these are limits, not fitted curve points. Source: p. 1 maximum ratings.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time specification and no breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification; VRRM/VDC ratings are not treated as breakdown data.
